profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GE Aerospace

positions.title: Software Engineer | Edison Engineering Development Program
positions.description:
Software Engineer in GE's Edison Engineering Development Program. Earned an accredited Master's degree in Computing while completing different rotations in the business, which included:

• Web Application Developer 			             	                                           	       	     
	- Collaborated with team to maintain web application to display bill of materials (BOM) and indicate 				 
             obsolescence status of components for Component Engineers to analyze, resulting in $2 million 
             cost savings.  
	- Redesigned data model for the web application using Java Spring and SQL to improve code 
           maintainability and performance.
	- Developed multiple features such as export to CSV, custom column selection, page navigation, 
             and flagging obsolescence mitigations that help users to perform job functions using Vue.js and 
             Java Spring.
	- Transformed data retrieval of source data into web application from script-based BPA tool to 
             automated ETL system.

• DataHub Developer			             	                              	        	       	    
	- Led the design and development of the Aviation Systems DataHub, a self-service platform that 
            enables users to ingest data into a central repository, transform, and visualize their data.
	- Installed and integrated software (Jenkins, Pentaho, GitHub, PostgreSQL, Dataiku, and Spotfire) to 
             enable source data to flow to end users following compliancy rules and regulations.
	- Trained a team of engineers to understand and develop the Aviation Systems DataHub.

• Embedded Software Engineer			             	                              	        
	- Implemented test application, in C, to validate that Memory Clearing Driver feature meets 
            requirements.
	- Created Python scripts to filter test results, decrease build time, and organize customer files.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
•	Verbal communication and active listening between students, tutors, and faculty. 
•	Assisted students in question and answer sessions in SMART Lab Courses.
•	Facilitate students to become independent learners
•	Courses: College Algebra, Pre-Calculus, and Finite Mathematics

positions.title: Engineering Mentor
positions.description:
•	Mentored and built a strong relationship with underexposed middle school students from the community.
•	Lead students to make a plan, design, build Tetrix robotics and setup GPS unit. 
•	Encourage kids to think outside of the box and inspire STEM field.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Assisted students in mathematics topics such as Geometry and Algebra.
Taught various subjects or guide students with homework.
